findings.description: Konrad Grubenmann was buried on 17 March 1787; the burial is entered in both the Teufen and the Stein (Appenzell Ausserrhoden) burial registers, each indexing him as Conrad Grubenmann aged 88, so a report naming either Teufen or Stein as the burial place is correct. The entries name his wife as Anna Reff (Teufen) and Anna Väfin (Stein); no marriage to her is indexed.

details.place: Teufen or Stein, Appenzell Ausserrhoden, Switzerland
